content.comment_body: Good morning, I would like to know if it is possible to connect to a [product_name] communication module to access the data blocks of the weekly and annual timer functions of a [product_name] controller. I want to modify the messages without sending SMS, using a graphical interface such as SCADA or an Android app. The goal is to update these values remotely through the Internet. Please let me know if my explanation is clear.
Hi, The main language on this forum is English. Please post your questions in English to receive better support. Thank you,
I'm not an expert in this module, but I found a manual indicating that Internet access is possible. Please see the attached document for reference. Hope this helps.
Changing values in the [product_name] controller via the [product_name] communication module is only possible using SMS.

Hello, Yes, this is possible. You need a SIM card with a static public IP address in the [product_name] communication module and should enable the VPN server feature. The connection is established via a VPN tunnel. An Android device acts as the VPN client, while the module is the server. Afterwards, simply enter the controller's address, and it's as if you're directly connected via cable. You can read and modify values as needed.
Can I modify variable values set in the VM area from the web server?
Yes. If you have the latest [product_name] controller ([version_no]), you can even design your own web pages for the web server.

So, it's not necessary to send SMS to change variables — if I have access to the web server, I can modify them directly? When you mention [version_no], do you mean [product_name] configuration software [version_no]?

English is not my first language, and I see it's not yours either. That's why I use Google Translate. According to Google Translate, your initial question suggested you had no network access, hence my reply about only SMS. But if you can reach the [product_name] controller via network, you can change values through the web server. You do not have to use only the VM area. Even the basic web server of earlier [product_name] models mirrors the controller’s display and functions, including cursor and F-keys, no matter the physical configuration. This allows variable changes via message texts. The latest [version_no] model has an enhanced web server, and you can use an additional program like [product_name] Web Editor to build your own custom websites.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are discussing how to remotely modify variables in a [product_name] controller using a [product_name] communication module, especially wishing to avoid SMS and use graphical tools such as web servers or Android apps. Initially, there is confusion about whether only SMS or network-based access is supported. The conversation clarifies that newer [product_name] controller versions allow variable modifications via the built-in web server if network or VPN access is available, and the latest models offer custom web page creation for flexible interfacing.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants to modify [product_name] controller variables remotely in a graphical interface, preferably over the Internet, via PC or smartphone, and without using SMS. Their goal is straightforward, secure access through a user-friendly online system.
